description: Uudenkaupungin OAS-tuulivoima-alueen ja -näkyvyyksien WMS-palvelu is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.lounaistieto.fi. The following map layers (technical name in brackets) are available through the WMS service for OAS wind power visions in Uusikaupunki: OAS wind power areas in Uusikaupunki 2014 (windpower visibility areas), visibility analyses of OAS wind power areas in Uusikaupunki - 1. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "WMS service for the Uusikaupunki OAS wind power area and sights" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Maankäyttö. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
